basis_fit: 39 training scenes only, 2048 neighbour-pair samples per scene, deterministic seed 20261030
validation_design: 9 scenes x 3 directions x 3 spatial masks x 3 training-quantile amplitudes = 243 constructed pairs
amplitude: half-pair perturbation delta, relative to broadband intensity; plus-minus truth is twice delta
constraints: one shared spatial coefficient shrunk to the most restrictive band bound; no independent clipping
labels: training-statistics-compatible / near-distribution / stress-test are heuristic diagnostics, not proof of distribution membership
noise: 0, 0.001, 0.005 times one fixed chromatic reference RMS; independent plus/minus noise, variance 2 sigma squared
inverse_prior: true baseline and true training-derived direction, no spatial mask or truth initialisation
regularisation: finite training-only grid in diagnostics.json; 100 iterations for every candidate and evaluation
noise_specific_regularisation_amendment: Before any validation coefficient inversion, use the same finite grid, same three training scenes, directions, local mask and middle amplitude separately at noise fractions 0, 0.001 and 0.005. This avoids interpreting noise-mismatched regularization bias as absence of recoverable information. Never expand the grid based on validation outcomes; retain boundary optima and nonconvergence.
solver_amendment_before_validation_inver: The initial unpreconditioned training grid selected a candidate with 0/9 converged cases. Preserve it as training_regularisation.json. Add a standard SPD Neumann-regularizer DCT preconditioner to the same B*B objective and repeat the identical training grid at 100 iterations. No validation inversion outcomes were used for this correction. The originally started combined operator/inverse job was stopped before inverse evaluation; its partial log is not a result.
diagnostic_recovery_threshold: relative L2 below 0.5 and cosine above 0.8; inverse also requires solver convergence
gate: At least 8/9 validation scenes in a complete direction/mask/scale/noise stratum must meet the inverse threshold before removing Oracle information or considering S4. Report every stratum and all failures. This is a diagnostic gate, not statistical significance.
network_comparison: Three model seeds separately; no checkpoint selection; response magnitude alone never counts as recovery
test_policy: No test archive access. No G4 decision by automatic script.
limitations: The matched-frequency control remains outside this differential experiment; spatial reconstruction benefits cannot be attributed to spectral recovery.
